This place is FIRE 🔥all u can eat top quality Japanese food culture
May 2019 • Solo
So I’ve been eating all kinds of bbq on my travels and Akira Bbq is ranked very high if not the top on my list of bbq in Vietnam. Finding this gem on trip advisor has already started my visit to Nha Trang off right. The sheer quality of meats and condiments brings ones bbq experience to a whole other level. From beginning to end it has been an unreal meal experience. As soon as u walk in, practically every server stops and greets u. And that makes u feel as almost being at home. Normally when eating at an all u can eat, I try to eat everything they have to offer and more. And Akira bbq u can, but in all honesty it’s not needed. U get completely full and satisfied from each offering they produce. If u are visiting Nha Trang this place is a must hit. Seriously I wouldn’t BS u about bbq this good. I hope u try Akira because I will be returning 🔥
